Veterinary Immunology Section
ICAR-INDIAN VETERINARY RESEARCH INSTITUTE
IZATNAGAR – 243 122 (U.P.)

Walk-in-Interview
Walk-in Interview is scheduled on 01st October, 2026 for engagement of purely temporary positions
under time bound DBT project entitled, “Evaluation of tumour-specific gene constructs for therapy of
canine mammary tumours”. The qualifications for the positions are as detailed below:
1. Project Assistant:
•
•
•
•

Monthly Emoluments: Rs. 20,000+ 18%HRA Per month
Essential Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in science or 3 years Diploma in Engineering &
Technology.
Desirable Qualifications: Experience of working in research & development laboratories, care and
handling of laboratory animals, animal cell culture, immunological & molecular biology Techniques,
proficiency in computer application & recording of data in Excel, PPT etc.
Age Limit: 50 years (As per DST guidelines)

2. Project Associate II:
• Monthly Emoluments: Rs. 35,000+ 18%HRA Per month
• Essential Qualification: Master’s degree in Natural/ life sciences or Agricultural sciences/ Veterinary
Science /Animal Science with 2 years’ experience in R&D and NET/GATE qualification or selection
through national level examination conducted by Central Govt. dept. or their agencies.
• Desirable Qualification: Experience of animal cell culture, maintaining cancer cell lines, molecular
biology and genetic engineering techniques, Immunological assays, Chemical Synthesis of
nanoparticles and biomolecules, laboratory animal handling, etc.
• Age Limit:35 Years (As per DST guidelines)
3 Field/Administrative Assistant:
• Monthly Emoluments: Rs. 18,000+18%HRA Per month
• Essential Qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline
• Desirable Qualification: Proficiency in computers, supported by valid degree/diploma and
Experience of handling office work including file generation & movements, recording data.
• Age Limit: 50 years (As per DST guidelines)
Interview Schedule: Date: 01st October, 2026, 10.00 AM at: Facility for Research and Training on
Bioassays and Biosensors (Bioengineering Building), Veterinary Immunology Section, ICAR - Indian
Veterinary Research Institute, Izatnagar – 243 122 Bareilly (U P)
Please Note:
1. Interested and eligible candidates may appear the walk-in-interview along with an application with one
colored photograph, Brief CV and one set of xerox copies of all certificates, publications, age and
category proof etc
2. The candidates must bring all the original certificates during the interview for verification by the
selection committee
3. No TA/ DA will be given for appearing in the walk-in-interview.
Contact Person: Dr. Sonal, Principal Scientist, Veterinary Immunology Section, ICAR-IVRI, Izatnagar
(Email sonalvet@gmail.com).
